rows.b: A full computer folded into a portable shape: efficient processor, battery, screen, and keyboard in one. It is the most common personal computer form today.
A future computer where vats of DNA strands run massively parallel computations by chemistry, storing exabytes in a thimble. SPECULATION: only tiny demos exist today.
Cylindrical drums with teeth of increasing length turn number wheels to multiply and divide, not just add. The operator sets the number on sliders and cranks through the calculation.
